requirements.text: Only DEPLOYMENT.md of apps/bayes-group-site is updated; nothing else in the app is changed.
Every existing acceptance test keeps passing.
The "Static deployment" section's list of prerendered files names dist/index.html as the file for /.
The "Static deployment" list of prerendered files names dist/services/index.html.
The "Static deployment" list of prerendered files names dist/systems/index.html.
The "Static deployment" list of prerendered files names dist/training/index.html.
The "Static deployment" list of prerendered files names dist/engagements/index.html.
The "Static deployment" list of prerendered files names dist/about/index.html.
The "Static deployment" list of prerendered files names dist/contact/index.html.
The "Static deployment" list of prerendered files names dist/404.html.
The listed prerendered files match the files `npm run build` actually writes.
The "SEO files" section says sitemap.xml lists the seven pages at https://thebayesgroup.com.
The "SEO files" section lists the sitemap pages as /, /services, /systems, /training, /engagements, /about and /contact.
The "SEO files" section mentions that dist/images/ holds the site's photos, copied from public/.
DEPLOYMENT.md still says to upload dist/ as it is to any static host, with no backend.
DEPLOYMENT.md still says no SPA rewrite rule or fallback is needed because every page is its own file.
DEPLOYMENT.md still says unknown addresses get 404.html.
DEPLOYMENT.md keeps the nginx example for serving 404.html.
DEPLOYMENT.md keeps the check of /services and /no-such-page.
The Security headers section of DEPLOYMENT.md is unchanged.
DEPLOYMENT.md stays short and specific to this site.
DEPLOYMENT.md has no generic hosting guides.
No Dockerfiles or CI files are added.

R3.test: DEPLOYMENT.md: Static deployment lists every prerendered page > dist/index.html is marked as the / page

R11.test: npm run build writes prerendered pages > dist/%s is a complete prerendered page
R11.quote: if (!fs.existsSync(p)) throw new Error(`Expected npm run build to write dist/${rel}`);
R11.gap: The build tests do not check that dist/systems/index.html or dist/engagements/index.html is written. No test compares the documented list against the actual build output, so extra or wrong entries in the doc are not caught.

R13.test: SEO files names the %s page / SEO files names the home page /
